description: Defines a Non-Player Character (NPC) within the game world, including their location, dialogue, and potential roles.

itemDefinitionRef.description: A strong reference to the item definition the NPC sells.

price.description: Optional override price for the item. If not set, a default price might be used.

description.description: A description of the NPC's appearance and personality.

locationRef.description: A strong reference to the NPC's current location (a com.cacheblasters.saga.proto.world.location record).

greeting.description: The initial line of dialogue the NPC says when interacted with.

vendorInfo.description: Information about the items this NPC sells.

questGiverInfo.description: Information about the quests this NPC offers.

quests.description: A list of strong references to quest definitions this NPC can offer.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for realm-specific properties (e.g., faction alignment).
